Choose Host: seat VIP #2 at Table 2
TURN 4 - order choice, locked VIP/Happy Hour bill, READY and first waiting loss
Discount.apply: 1500 -> VIP 1350 -> Happy Hour 1080 cents, rounding each step. New orders only.
Customer discount only: 1500 -> 1350 cents. Existing orders remain unchanged in either branch.
Chef may prepare the order taken this turn. The Waiter has already acted; a dish becoming READY on turn 4 cannot be served until a later turn.
Automatic cashier follows Restaurant.findOldestPayableCustomer / settlePayment: customer #1 pays $9.00 on turn 4; VIP #2 is not ready. The pre-existing Salad bill is unchanged by Happy Hour.
TURN 5 - one turn remaining, recovery and later-turn serving
CLI displays updated GameView. Host chooses Wait through Controller -> StaffTeam -> Host; its capacity remains independent of Waiter.
Chef chooses Wait. finishTurn(5) cannot finish VIP eating in the same turn; no VIP payment or waiting loss occurs after service. completeTurn(5); GameResult remains IN_PROGRESS.
TURNS 6-7 - eating, deferred payment, locked bill and table release
Turn 6: startTurn; resolveTurnStart(false); Happy Hour remaining is 0. Host/Waiter/Chef choose Wait. These follow the same guarded interfaces.

Turn 6 penalties/completion/result check run normally. Turn 7 registers Regular #3, resolves the opening, seats #3 with Host, takes its Pasta order and prepares the first unit. VIP #2 remains ready to pay.

Revenue and average use the locked paid bill and recorded satisfaction. Happy Hour expiration does not recalculate the order. Normal branch: $10.80, satisfaction 100. Alternative: $13.50, satisfaction 95.
TURNS 8-18 - remaining mixed customers, combos and final result

Actual stage3-victory priorities: Host seats first queued customer; Waiter serves, otherwise takes order, otherwise seats; Chef prepares the first eligible order. New combos follow the same Order/Chef/Waiter/Cashier lifecycle.

Both full runs pay 5 customers. Activate on turn 4: $83.70, average 87.20. Keep unused with identical service priorities: $86.40, average 86.20. The choice changes money and satisfaction, not the victory label in these runs. Critic #6 cannot pay by turn 18.
